{{Top|leg}}
'''Cold boxes''' were used to store valuables, such as security keys. The contents on a cold box could only be read by physically accessing the box and connecting it to a computer, making it a safe way to keep sensitive data off a network where slicers could access it.

The [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] utilized cold boxes to store transponder data that was contraband to the public. One of these cold boxes ended up stolen and eventually found its way into [[Nebit's tribe/Legends|Nebit's clan]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]/[[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] via R1-G4.{{Fact}}
